requirement: Capture baseline metadata (repo SHA, timestamp, environment).
passRule: Baseline metadata is captured in verification output.

requirement: Capture raw evidence for required repository files.
passRule: All required evidence files are present and fingerprinted.

requirement: Required Help Center labels exist exactly.
passRule: All required labels are present: area:help-center, phase:1..7, type:epic|feature|qa|chore, priority:p1|p2, north-star.

requirement: Milestones HC-P1 through HC-P7 exist.
passRule: Milestone titles include HC-P1, HC-P2, HC-P3, HC-P4, HC-P5, HC-P6, HC-P7.

requirement: Each HC milestone has exactly 5 issues (1 epic + 4 non-epic).
passRule: For every HC milestone, issue count is 5 and epic count is 1.

requirement: All HC milestones are closed after completion.
passRule: All milestones HC-P1..HC-P7 are state=closed.

requirement: At most one HC milestone is active during rollout.
passRule: Open HC milestones are <= 1.

requirement: Closed HC issues have acceptance checklists checked.
passRule: Closed HC issues contain checklist entries and all are checked.

requirement: Closed HC issues have linked PR closure evidence.
passRule: Every closed HC issue has at least one closing PR reference.

requirement: HelpTopic includes audience, journeyStep, keywords, outcomes fields.
passRule: HelpTopic type includes audience, journeyStep, keywords, outcomes.

requirement: buildHelpHashPath supports topic, anchor, q, context in the payload contract.
passRule: buildHelpHashPath payload type includes topic, anchor, q, context.

requirement: buildHelpHashPath encodes q and context query params.
passRule: buildHelpHashPath sets q and context in URLSearchParams when present.

requirement: HelpDefinition type exists in renderer help domain.
passRule: A HelpDefinition type or interface exists with id, term, meaning, appliesTo, relatedTopicId.

requirement: package.json defines check:help-integrity script.
passRule: scripts.check:help-integrity is defined.

requirement: check:help-integrity points to scripts/check-help-integrity.cjs.
passRule: scripts.check:help-integrity invokes node scripts/check-help-integrity.cjs.

requirement: scripts/check-help-integrity.cjs exists.
passRule: scripts/check-help-integrity.cjs exists on disk.

requirement: CI executes npm run check:help-integrity.
passRule: ci.yml contains a step running npm run check:help-integrity.

requirement: Branch protection on main requires Help Integrity status check.
passRule: main branch protection required status checks include Help Integrity.

requirement: Current integrity check command passes on repository state.
passRule: Command exits zero.

requirement: Help-related renderer tests pass.
passRule: HelpPage, ImportPage, ReportsPage, and DashboardPage tests all pass.

requirement: Negative check: missing heading scenario fails integrity command with actionable output.
source: temp workspace mutation + node scripts/help-tools.cjs check
passRule: Mutated missing-heading scenario exits non-zero and output is actionable.

requirement: Negative check: duplicate heading edge-case scenario fails integrity command.
source: temp workspace mutation + node scripts/help-tools.cjs check
passRule: Duplicate-heading edge-case exits non-zero.

requirement: Negative check: stale generated output drift fails integrity command.
source: temp workspace mutation + node scripts/help-tools.cjs check
passRule: Drift mutation exits non-zero with stale generation guidance.

requirement: North-star scenario for brand-new users is documented with six outcomes.
passRule: Document includes all six new-user outcomes.

requirement: North-star scenario for experienced users includes F1/search/context under 30 seconds.
passRule: Document includes F1 + search/jump + meaning retrieval under 30s.
